item.tib: bde bar gshegs pa mchod pa'i bye brag 'bul ba yid 'dzin pad mo dbang gi dges tshal
item.coloph: de ltar mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshig rgyan gyi rang bzhin yid 'dzin pad mo dbang gi dges tshal zhes/ dmu rigs nyi ma'i ming can gyis chu mo bya yi lo zla ba gsum pa'i dus tshes khyad par can gyi nyin/ dpal ldan bla ma'i gzims khang mngon dga' zhes bya bar brtsams pa dge legs 'phel/ dge tshogs ci mchis dmigs yul gtsor byas mkha' mnyam kun bzang dbyings su thim par mdzad du gsol//
